RGD Tech Refund Policy 2026

_RGD Tech | Policy and Knowledge Base | Version 2026.1 | Effective 1 July 2026_

Policy Overview

This policy defines when RGD Tech customers are eligible for refunds, how refunds are calculated, the payment method used for refunds, and the expected processing timelines.

Refund Eligibility

Refunds are available after an eligible return, approved cancellation, or confirmed defective-product case.



Refund eligibility depends on the product category, the applicable return window, product condition, and the outcome of inspection where inspection is required.



A refund is not automatically approved merely because a customer requests one; the underlying return or cancellation must satisfy the applicable policy.

Refund Time Limits

Laptops are generally eligible for return and refund consideration within 30 calendar days of delivery.



Smartphones are generally eligible within 15 calendar days of delivery.



Tablets are generally eligible within 15 calendar days of delivery.



Accessories are generally eligible within 10 calendar days of delivery.



The order record and delivery date in the RGD Tech transactional system determine whether the applicable window has been met.

Refund Calculation

The normal refund amount is the eligible amount actually paid for the returned item, after applicable discounts.



Shipping charges are refundable only when the return is caused by an RGD Tech error, a confirmed defect, or another exception explicitly approved under policy.



Partial refunds may be issued when only part of an order is returned.

Refund Processing

After an approved return passes inspection, RGD Tech normally initiates the refund within 2 business days.



Customers should normally see the refunded amount within 5–7 business days after processing, depending on the payment provider.



The refund is normally sent back to the original payment method.

High-Value Refunds

Refunds above INR 50,000 require Finance approval before final processing.



Support agents may collect the required information and create the refund request but may not independently approve a high-value refund.

Finance approval is recorded against the refund transaction.

Damaged, Defective, and Exceptional Cases

Confirmed manufacturing defects may qualify for a refund even when additional review is required.



Physical damage caused after delivery may be excluded unless an approved exception applies.



Where a replacement is offered instead of a refund, the customer must be informed of the available resolution.

Discounted and Promotional Orders

Refunds for promotional purchases are based on the amount actually paid for the returned item.



If a promotional condition required multiple items to be purchased together, returning one item may require recalculation of the promotion.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How long does a refund take? A: RGD Tech normally initiates an approved refund within 2 business days and customers should normally receive it within 5–7 business days after processing.



Q: Can a support agent approve a refund above INR 50,000? A: No. Finance approval is required.



Q: Where is a customer's actual refund status stored? A: The live status is stored in RGD Tech's transactional system; this policy only defines the rules and expected timelines.

RGD Tech Return Policy 2026

_RGD Tech | Policy and Knowledge Base | Version 2026.1 | Effective 1 July 2026_

Return Policy Overview

RGD Tech accepts eligible product returns when the request is made within the applicable return window and the product satisfies the condition requirements.

Return Windows

Laptops: 30 calendar days from delivery.



Smartphones: 15 calendar days from delivery.



Tablets: 15 calendar days from delivery.



Accessories: 10 calendar days from delivery.



The delivery date is determined from the shipment record.

Product Condition

Products should normally be returned in usable condition with required accessories and packaging.



Serial numbers, IMEI information where applicable, and product identity must match the order record.



Missing accessories may affect the final resolution.

Non-Returnable Situations

Products outside the applicable return window are normally not eligible for a change-of-mind return.



Products showing customer-caused physical damage may be rejected.



Products modified or repaired by unauthorized parties may be excluded.



Consumable or hygiene-sensitive accessories identified as non-returnable at purchase are excluded.

Defective Products

Confirmed manufacturing defects may qualify for return, replacement, repair, or refund according to the warranty and refund policies.



Customers may be asked to complete reasonable troubleshooting before a technical return is authorized.

Return Shipping

RGD Tech normally provides return instructions for approved returns.



When the return is caused by a confirmed RGD Tech error or manufacturing defect, RGD Tech may arrange or reimburse return shipping according to the case.

Inspection

Returned products may be inspected before a refund is finalized.

Inspection findings are recorded in the transactional system and can determine whether a return is approved, rejected, or routed for warranty handling.

FAQs

Q: Is every product return automatically approved? A: No. Eligibility depends on the return window, product condition, and applicable exceptions.



Q: Where is the status of a particular return stored? A: In RGD Tech's transactional database.

RGD Tech Shipping Policy 2026

_RGD Tech | Policy and Knowledge Base | Version 2026.1 | Effective 1 July 2026_

Shipping Overview

This policy describes standard and express delivery, shipping charges, delivery exceptions, and procedures for delayed, lost, or damaged shipments.

Delivery Estimates

Standard shipping normally takes 3–5 business days after dispatch.



Express shipping normally takes 1–2 business days after dispatch.



Delivery estimates are not guarantees and may vary because of carrier, weather, public holidays, remote locations, or operational disruption.

Shipping Charges

Shipping charges depend on product, destination, service level, and applicable promotions.



Eligible orders may qualify for free standard shipping.



Express shipping may carry an additional charge.

Delays

When a shipment exceeds the expected delivery period, support should first verify the carrier status and latest estimated delivery date.



Repeated carrier exceptions should be escalated according to the support policy.

Lost or Damaged Shipments

A shipment marked lost by the carrier may require carrier investigation before replacement or refund is finalized.



For visible delivery damage, customers should report the issue promptly and provide requested evidence where applicable.



Resolution depends on the investigation and the applicable return/refund policy.

Address Changes

Address changes may be possible before dispatch.



Once a shipment has been handed to the carrier, address changes may depend on carrier capabilities and may not be guaranteed.

International Shipping

International availability, duties, taxes, and delivery times vary by destination.



Customers are responsible for charges explicitly identified as customer-paid import duties or taxes unless an order states otherwise.

FAQs

Q: Where is the live tracking status? A: The live shipment status and tracking number are stored in the transactional system.



Q: Does 3–5 business days include time before dispatch? A: No. The standard estimate refers to the normal delivery period after dispatch.

RGD Tech Warranty Policy 2026

_RGD Tech | Policy and Knowledge Base | Version 2026.1 | Effective 1 July 2026_

Warranty Overview

RGD Tech provides limited warranty coverage for eligible products against specified manufacturing defects during the applicable warranty period.

Warranty Periods

Laptops: 24 months.



Smartphones: 12 months.



Tablets: 12 months.



Accessories: 6 months unless a product-specific warranty states otherwise.

Covered Issues

Manufacturing defects affecting normal operation may be covered.



Hardware failures that occur under normal intended use may qualify for warranty service.



Coverage is subject to product verification and applicable exclusions.

Exclusions

Physical damage, liquid damage, misuse, abuse, unauthorized repair, modification, and normal cosmetic wear are generally excluded.



Damage caused by incompatible accessories or use outside published specifications may be excluded.



Software issues caused by unsupported modifications may not qualify for hardware replacement.

Warranty Claim Process

Support may perform basic troubleshooting before opening a warranty claim.



Proof of purchase or order identification may be required.



Technical staff may diagnose the product before approving repair or replacement.

Repair and Replacement

RGD Tech may choose repair or replacement based on defect, availability, product condition, and applicable policy.



If replacement stock is unavailable, another approved resolution may be offered.

Warranty and Returns

A return request inside the standard return period is handled under the return policy unless the case is specifically routed as a warranty defect.

After the standard return window, confirmed defects are generally handled through warranty service rather than change-of-mind returns.

FAQs

Q: Is physical damage covered? A: Normally no.



Q: How long is the ProBook 15 warranty? A: 24 months under the standard laptop warranty.



Q: Is the warranty status of a particular customer's product stored in this PDF? A: No. The purchase/order records determine the transaction history; this document defines warranty rules.

RGD Tech Order Cancellation Policy 2026

_RGD Tech | Policy and Knowledge Base | Version 2026.1 | Effective 1 July 2026_

Cancellation Overview

Customers may request cancellation, but whether cancellation is possible depends on the current order and shipment status.

Before Shipment

Orders may generally be cancelled without a cancellation fee before shipment.



The customer receives a refund according to the refund policy when payment has already been captured.

After Shipment

Once an order has shipped, cancellation may no longer be possible.



The customer may instead need to receive the product and use the applicable return process.

After Delivery

Delivered orders are not treated as cancellations; eligible cases should follow the return policy.

Promotional Orders

Cancellation of promotional orders may affect promotional pricing and any associated refund calculation.

Automatic Cancellation

RGD Tech may cancel orders for payment failure, inventory unavailability, suspected fraud, or other operational reasons.



Customers should receive an appropriate notification where required.

Refunds After Cancellation

When a cancellation is approved after payment capture, the refund follows the refund policy and original payment method rules.

FAQs

Q: Can a shipped order always be cancelled? A: No. Once shipped, the customer may need to use the return process.



Q: Where do we check whether a specific order has shipped? A: In the live order and shipment records.

RGD Tech Payment Policy 2026

_RGD Tech | Policy and Knowledge Base | Version 2026.1 | Effective 1 July 2026_

Accepted Payment Methods

RGD Tech supports major credit and debit cards, UPI, and eligible net-banking methods.



Available methods may vary by checkout context.

Payment Authorization

A payment may initially be authorized before final capture.



An order should not be treated as fully paid solely because a payment attempt was initiated.

Failed Payments

A failed payment may require the customer to retry using an available payment method.



Temporary authorization holds may reverse automatically depending on the payment provider.



Bank or payment-provider reversals may take 3–5 business days.

Duplicate Payments

If a customer believes they were charged twice, support should verify payment records before promising a refund.



Confirmed duplicate successful payments should be investigated and corrected according to Finance procedures.

Refunds

Refunds normally return to the original payment method.



Payment-provider processing time is outside RGD Tech's direct control.



High-value refunds are subject to the approval requirements in the refund policy.

Payment Security

Support agents must never request or store a customer's full card number, CVV, password, or authentication code.



Sensitive payment credentials must remain within approved payment-provider systems.

FAQs

Q: How long can a failed card payment reversal take? A: Typically 3–5 business days, depending on the provider.



Q: Where is the amount and status of a customer's payment stored? A: In the transactional payment records.

RGD Tech Customer Support Policy

_RGD Tech | Policy and Knowledge Base | Version 2026.1 | Effective 1 July 2026_

Support Overview

RGD Tech support is responsible for resolving customer questions, collecting relevant information, applying approved procedures, and escalating cases that require specialist or management action.

Support Roles

Support Agents handle normal customer queries, order status questions, basic returns, and first-level troubleshooting.



Senior Support Agents handle complex cases and supervise escalations.



Finance handles payment disputes and high-value refund approvals.



Technical Specialists handle advanced troubleshooting and technical diagnostics.



Operations manages shipment and fulfillment exceptions.

Priority Levels and SLA

P1: critical customer-impacting issue. Initial response target: 1 hour.



P2: major issue affecting normal use or requiring urgent intervention. Initial response target: 4 hours.



P3: standard issue. Initial response target: 1 business day.

Return and Refund Requests

Agents must verify the order and product before making a policy determination.



Agents should use the return and refund policies rather than promising an outcome before eligibility is established.



Refunds above INR 50,000 require Finance approval.

Technical Issues

Agents should follow the troubleshooting guide for supported symptoms.



If prescribed troubleshooting does not resolve the issue, a warranty or technical diagnostic case may be opened.



Agents must not instruct customers to perform unsafe repairs or unauthorized hardware modifications.

Escalation Rules

Payment disputes and high-value refunds should be routed to Finance.



Shipment exceptions should be routed to Operations when normal carrier handling is insufficient.



Persistent hardware faults should be routed to Technical Support.



Cases with significant customer impact or unresolved repeated contacts should be escalated to a Senior Support Agent.

Customer Communication

Agents must communicate the applicable policy accurately and avoid promising exceptions without approval.



Sensitive credentials must never be requested.



Case notes should contain the relevant order, product, issue, actions taken, and resolution.

Ticket Closure

A ticket may be closed when the requested action is completed, the customer has been informed, or the case has been appropriately transferred.



Open dependencies such as pending refunds or inspections should remain visible until resolved.

FAQs

Q: Who approves refunds above INR 50,000? A: Finance.



Q: Who handles advanced hardware troubleshooting? A: Technical Support.



Q: Where is the customer's actual order status stored? A: In the transactional database.

RGD Tech Troubleshooting Guide

_RGD Tech | Policy and Knowledge Base | Version 2026.1 | Effective 1 July 2026_

Troubleshooting Principles

Support agents should first identify the product, symptom, recent changes, and whether the problem is intermittent or persistent. Only approved and safe steps should be recommended.

Laptop: Will Not Turn On

Confirm the power adapter is connected correctly.



Check for charging indicators and try a known-good power outlet.



Disconnect non-essential accessories and retry.



If the device remains unresponsive, stop troubleshooting and create a technical diagnostic case.

Laptop: Overheating

Place the laptop on a hard, unobstructed surface.



Check whether ventilation openings are blocked.



Close unnecessary high-resource applications.



Allow the device to cool before continuing normal use.



If overheating persists, especially with unexpected shutdowns, burning smell, or abnormal fan behavior, stop use and escalate to Technical Support.

Laptop: Battery Drain

Check battery usage by applications.



Confirm the charging adapter is recognized.



Apply approved operating-system updates where appropriate.



If battery capacity appears abnormal or the device shuts down unexpectedly, route the case for warranty assessment.

Laptop: Wi-Fi Problems

Verify Wi-Fi is enabled and the correct network is selected.



Restart the device and network connection.



Test another network when available to distinguish device and network issues.



Escalate persistent hardware-related connectivity failures.

Smartphone: Charging Problems

Check the cable and power source.



Inspect the charging port without inserting tools or liquids.

Restart the device and retry charging.



If the device becomes unusually hot while charging or repeatedly fails to charge, stop use and escalate.

Smartphone: Battery Drain

Check battery usage by application.



Disable unnecessary background activity.



Confirm the device software is current.



Persistent abnormal drain may require warranty diagnostics.

Tablet: Performance Issues

Restart the tablet.



Close unused applications.



Check available storage.



Install approved system updates.



Persistent performance problems should be assessed by technical support.

section: When to Create a Warranty Case
chunk_text:
When to Create a Warranty Case

Create a warranty case when a likely hardware defect persists after reasonable troubleshooting and the product is within the applicable warranty period.



Warranty eligibility must be checked against the warranty policy and the customer's transaction history.

Safety and Escalation

Never instruct customers to open the device, bypass safety systems, or perform unauthorized repairs.



Smoke, burning smell, swelling battery, liquid intrusion, or dangerous electrical behavior requires immediate cessation of use and technical escalation.

Purpose and Scope This document defines internal financial-operational rules used by RGD Tech administrators and authorized finance leadership. The policy covers refund authorization, exceptional financial adjustments, internal reconciliation, and operational controls. |**Topic**|**Policy / Information**| |---|---| |Standard refunds|Customer-service refunds that satisfy the published policy may follow the

Internal Financial Controls Administrators should preserve an auditable relationship between order, payment, return, refund, and approval records. |**Topic**|**Policy / Information**| |---|---| |Audit trail|Record order ID, payment ID, return ID, refund amount, reason, and

RAG Access Classification

This document is classified as **admin** . Support users must not receive its contents through retrieval or context formation.



It is intentionally included to demonstrate role-aware Pinecone filtering and post-retrieval ALC validation.
